title: Isolate the Returned Borrow
goal: Unlink an unused input reference so the caller can mutate it after the function call.
hints: Look at `delim.clear()`. Why does the compiler think `delim` is still borrowed?
The return value only comes from `s`. `_delim` needs a separate lifetime parameter so its borrow ends immediately after the call.
explanation: Giving both parameters the lifetime `'a` forces `delim` to remain borrowed for as long as `word` is alive, causing `E0502` when calling `delim.clear()`. Giving `_delim` its own lifetime parameter `'b` unlinks it from the returned slice so its borrow ends when `first_word` returns. Using `&'b str` for `s` fails because the return type promises lifetime `'a`, which does not match `'b`. Using `String` causes `E0308` type mismatch because the caller passes string references.
